source: Every 9th memory of LoCoMo conv-26, first 45, labelled by hand with the entities extraction should find.
policy: An entity is something a later question could NAME to find this memory. Proper nouns, specific events, activities, works, places, animals and concrete objects count. Generic relational nouns (friends, family, kids, people, mentors), abstract feelings, and bare pronouns do not -- they discriminate nothing, and the span filter is meant to drop them. Text inside [shared image: ...] is part of the memory and is labelled the same way. 'types' lists every defensible type for the span, first one canonical: zero-shot labels are genuinely ambiguous (pottery is defensible as a creative work, an activity, or an object), so the typed score accepts any of them and the untyped score ignores type entirely.
